records.headline: EASA AD mandates repetitive Trent XWB-84 IP compressor inspection
records.summary: EASA issued an AD requiring repetitive borescope inspection of the Trent XWB-84 intermediate-pressure compressor following reported blade distress.

references.fetched_text_snippet: This AD requires repetitive borescope inspections of the IP compressor and, depending on findings, replacement of affected blades.

records.oem_regulator_position: EASA classifies the condition as an unsafe condition requiring repetitive inspection.

quotes.text: repetitive borescope inspections of the IP compressor
